Variable_Definitions: B = total transferred data; T = execution time
Inputs: Measured transferred data; measured execution time
Paper_Title: Memory Bandwidth Prediction in NUMA Architecture Using Supervised Machine Learning
Applicability: NUMA/HPC workloads where transferred data and execution time are measured.
Limitations: The paper additionally models bandwidth using problem size and thread count; this relationship is a measurement definition, not a universal sustained-bandwidth guarantee.
